'''Lloco''' was a commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Lloco commented on the entry for [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation's]] [[Firestorm-1]].<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
